speed: n/a (locked frame; she runs into it)
start_frame: Straight across the hall from the south-east doors to the low curtain, lens on the flagstones: the curtain hanging above her like a stage cloth, the fifteen-inch door beneath it, ten-inch Alice running in from the table side.
end_frame: The same frame with both her hands hauling at the little door: at her size it is a proper door, shoulder-high and correctly proportioned to her — and it does not give at all.
constraint_honoured: 'At ten inches the fifteen-inch door is her own scale — the first door in the hall she could actually walk through, and it will not open': the frame holds door and girl together so the new proportion is plain.
movement_note: Her run supplies the movement; the camera stays on the flagstones at her eye-line as the ten-inch state requires. Her face is never near enough to the 28 mm to stretch.
